import dspy
from dspy.utils.asyncify import get_limiter


def sleeper(wait, value):
    sleep(wait)
    return value


async_sleeper = dspy.asyncify(sleeper)


async def run_once(capacity, tasks=6, wait=0.2):
    with dspy.context(async_max_workers=capacity):
        limiter = get_limiter()
        start = perf_counter()
        results = await asyncio.gather(*[async_sleeper(wait, i) for i in range(tasks)])

        'slow_tokens': slow_tokens,

        'same_limiter_object': slow_id == fast_id,

from dspy.utils.dummies import DummyLM


class RoundAwareDummyLM(DummyLM):

    for i in range(4)
